input.prompt: Animate the first frame exactly: same framing, composition, lighting, setting and character. A solo wushu changquan performer shows the second international compulsory long-fist routine, crisp, fast and powerful, then sharp stops. She stands at attention, feet together, fists at her hips (yubei shi, the ready stance), completely still. About 1.7 seconds in, on the big hit, she snaps both open palms across in front of her chest, feet together (bingbu shizi zhang, cross palms). About 2.6 seconds in she swings both straight arms in one big vertical circle (lun bi). About 3.5 seconds in she drops into a deep drop stance (pubu), one leg straight along the water, and slaps her palm down beside the straight leg (pubu pai zhang). About 4.3 seconds in she rises onto both feet, stamps one foot (zhenjiao) and pounds her right fist down into her open left palm in a half squat (za quan), and holds that pose dead still to the end. Each named move lands exactly on a beat of the reference audio. One performer only, the same woman from start to end: two arms, two legs, one head; no limb appears, vanishes, doubles or detaches; nobody else ever appears. Real weight and momentum: knees bend on every landing, the planted foot never slides, sneakers stay on the water between steps. She stays inside the centre of the frame, travelling at most a step or two. The camera is LOCKED OFF on a tripod: no pan, no zoom, no push, no reframing, the horizon stays level. Her mouth stays closed. Same face and eyes as the first frame; she keeps her high ponytail, her orange bands and the round white '1420 MHz' patch on her LEFT upper arm. One continuous shot at real speed, no slow motion, no cuts. No captions, no text.
